text: His brothers were jealous. "Yusuf and his brother are more beloved to our father than we are," they said.
Some of them wanted to kill him. One said: do not kill him... throw him into the bottom of the well.
So they asked their father to send Yusuf out with them tomorrow, to eat well and play.
Hazrat Yaqub said: "It saddens me that you should take him... and I fear that a wolf would eat him while you are not watching."
Without knowing it, he had just handed them their excuse.
They took him out, and together they put him into the bottom of the well.
And there, in the dark, alone, Allah sent him a promise.
"You will surely inform them, someday, about this affair of theirs... while they do not perceive."
That night, the brothers came home to their father, weeping.
"O our father, we went racing each other, and left Yusuf with our things... and a wolf ate him."
And they brought his shirt, with false blood on it.
But their father saw through it. "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something. So patience is most fitting."
Patience is most fitting. Sabrun jameel.
Remember those words... because he will say them again.
